text:
This looks like a leftover meal tray. "On the plate" means the remaining bread pieces (crusts of toast or croissant) and a bit of butter.

The plate holds about 5-6 bread and croissant fragments, roughly 45 g total, plus about 10 g of butter smears.

Bread and croissant come to about 45 g × 3.5 kcal/g ≈ 155 kcal. Butter at 10 g × 7.2 kcal/g ≈ 72 kcal. That totals about 227 kcal, which seems high for leftovers, so I'll lower the estimate to about 190 kcal over roughly 50 g.
